```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(category_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(market_cap_share = category_market_cap_usd / sum(category_market_cap_usd)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, market_cap_share, median, .desc = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = market_cap_share, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_rect(
    data = tibble(
      event = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
      start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
      end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11"))
    ),
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = tibble(
      event = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
      date = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
      y = c(0.82, 0.62)
    ),
    aes(x = date, y = y, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    size = 2.8,
    label.size = 0,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    title = "How Crypto Market Capitalization Is Distributed",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Each band is one category's share of total daily market cap (100% per day).",
      "Shaded windows mark the Luna/UST crash and FTX collapse.",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market capitalization",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: daily_prices.parquet and coin-level metadata.",
      "Market caps summed by category and day."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )
```

```{r}
ParquetFileReader$create("data/daily_prices.parquet")$GetSchema()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarize(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = as_date(
      parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("ymd", "B d, Y"))
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```
